# LaunchPulse

> Personalized 90-second launch video teardowns, AI search visibility (/llms.txt + JSON-LD) fixes, and 24/7 high-intent buyer radar for newly launched SaaS & AI founders.

LaunchPulse helps Vibe Coders, solo SaaS founders, and indie engineering teams bridge the gap between shipping a product and getting paying customers. It combines passive, non-intrusive technical SEO/AEO/UX diagnostics with real-time community buyer intent monitoring across Hacker News, Reddit, and GitHub.

## Core Capabilities
- **Instant Passive Launch & AEO Audit**: Checks meta robots, `/llms.txt` AI search manifests, `SoftwareApplication` JSON-LD schemas, clickjacking/CSP hardening headers, mobile viewport overflow, and bottom-of-funnel `/vs/` comparison gaps.
- **Personalized 90-Second Video Teardown**: Generates an audio-first narrated walkthrough inspecting the founder's live product, red-boxing conversion leaks, and showcasing waiting community buyers.
- **Copy-Paste Cursor & Claude Code Fix Pack ($19 one-time)**: Ready-to-run prompts and generated `/llms.txt` + JSON-LD files to ship every fix in under 15 minutes.
- **24/7 Buyer Intent Radar Pro ($29/month)**: Continuous monitoring for high-intent developer threads asking for tools in your exact niche, with first 3 leads unlocked free to verify before paying.
